game.name: Star Ocean : The Last Hope (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)(Disc 2)
game.desc: The story takes place in the distant future, where the planet is ravaged by a third world war that has devastated the Earth. The human race, both actor and victim of this chaos, plans a journey to the stellar ocean to find a habitable planet. Edge Maverick and Reimi Saionji arrive on the planet Aeos, without suspecting that in reality, we are not alone in the universe... nnExplore the galaxy, forge alliances and provoke conflicts with the various aliens you encounter, and discover an unthinkable danger that threatens all of creation. Like the other installments in the series, The Last Hope features a dynamic real-time combat system.
